items.title: Phil Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 27, 2023
items.q: I had every Spike Jones record made ever... I saw every Spike Jones... if there were two musicians I would be there... those two are Louis Armstrong and the other was Spike Jones.

ctx.x: That the musicians got through it without sort of cracking up sometimes. I mean it sounds like Spike Jones meets Sauter-Finegan or something.

Absolutely. Spike Jones was, believe it or not my nickname at Phillips Exeter was “Spike” and it was because of Spike Jones. I had every Spike Jones record made ever. Oh man. I mean I even had a Spike Jones band with the — and I borrowed the pistol from the athletic department [scats]. [Sings] You always hurt/the one —
Those guys could play though, man.
